SELECT
FROM TRAVEL_PACKAGE tp JOIN SPOT_TRAVEL st ON st.spot_idx = tp.spot_idx JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = tp.seller_user_idx WHERE tp.package_status = 'APPROVED' AND COALESCE(st.spot_active, 0) = 0 AND (tp.end_date IS NULL OR tp.end_date >= CURDATE()) ORDER BY tp.approved_at DESC, tp.package_idx DESC

SELECT tpr.package_revision_idx, tpr.package_idx, tpr.seller_user_idx, tpr.package_title, tpr.package_summary, tpr.package_content, tpr.package_price, tpr.currency_code, tpr.start_date, tpr.end_date, tpr.min_people, tpr.max_people, tpr.main_image_path, tpr.revision_status, tpr.reject_reason, tpr.requested_at, tpr.reviewed_by_user_idx, tpr.reviewed_at, tp.package_title AS current_package_title, st.name AS spot_name, st.region AS spot_region, u.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM TRAVEL_PACKAGE_REVISION tpr JOIN TRAVEL_PACKAGE tp ON tp.package_idx = tpr.package_idx JOIN SPOT_TRAVEL st ON st.spot_idx = tp.spot_idx JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = tpr.seller_user_idx WHERE tpr.package_idx = #{packageIdx} AND tpr.revision_status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY tpr.requested_at DESC, tpr.package_revision_idx DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRAVEL_PACKAGE_REVISION ( package_idx, seller_user_idx, package_title, package_summary, package_content, package_price, currency_code, start_date, end_date, min_people, max_people, main_image_path, revision_status ) VALUES ( #{packageIdx}, #{sellerUserIdx}, #{packageTitle}, #{packageSummary}, #{packageContent}, #{packagePrice}, #{currencyCode}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{minPeople}, #{maxPeople}, #{mainImagePath}, #{revisionStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT tpr.package_revision_idx, tpr.package_idx, tpr.seller_user_idx, tpr.package_title, tpr.package_summary, tpr.package_content, tpr.package_price, tpr.currency_code, tpr.start_date, tpr.end_date, tpr.min_people, tpr.max_people, tpr.main_image_path, tpr.revision_status, tpr.reject_reason, tpr.requested_at, tpr.reviewed_by_user_idx, tpr.reviewed_at, tp.package_title AS current_package_title, st.name AS spot_name, st.region AS spot_region, u.nickname AS seller_nickname FROM TRAVEL_PACKAGE_REVISION tpr JOIN TRAVEL_PACKAGE tp ON tp.package_idx = tpr.package_idx JOIN SPOT_TRAVEL st ON st.spot_idx = tp.spot_idx JOIN USERS u ON u.user_idx = tpr.seller_user_idx WHERE tpr.package_revision_idx = #{packageRevisionIdx} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE TRAVEL_PACKAGE tp JOIN TRAVEL_PACKAGE_REVISION tpr ON tpr.package_idx = tp.package_idx SET tp.package_title = tpr.package_title, tp.package_summary = tpr.package_summary, tp.package_content = tpr.package_content, tp.package_price = tpr.package_price, tp.currency_code = tpr.currency_code, tp.start_date = tpr.start_date, tp.end_date = tpr.end_date, tp.min_people = tpr.min_people, tp.max_people = tpr.max_people, tp.main_image_path = tpr.main_image_path, tp.updated_at = NOW() WHERE tpr.package_revision_idx = #{packageRevisionIdx} AND tpr.revision_status = 'PENDING' AND tp.package_status = 'APPROVED'

UPDATE TRAVEL_PACKAGE_REVISION SET revision_status = 'APPROVED', reject_reason = NULL, reviewed_by_user_idx = #{reviewedByUserIdx}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE package_revision_idx = #{packageRevisionIdx} AND revision_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE TRAVEL_PACKAGE_REVISION SET revision_status = 'REJECTED', reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewed_by_user_idx = #{reviewedByUserIdx}, reviewed_at = NOW() WHERE package_revision_idx = #{packageRevisionIdx} AND revision_status = 'PENDING'
